text:
incident-bot: ALERT · High error rate for /v1/stream in ap-southeast-1 (5xx > 15% for 3m). Paging @oncall-sre. Incident: INC-20045. War room: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/333333333 (passcode: rwd123) — join for triage

Sarah Li: oncall-sre, did pager come through? If you're free I can take initial owner until you join.

oncall-sre: Pager confirmed, joining war room now. I'm in the call. Quick note: see spike at 03:18 UTC, lots of stream cancellations and backend errors from model-runtime.

Tom Nguyen: I can pull autoscale and pod health info. Assign owner?

Sarah Li: taking owner. Assigning follow-ups: owner = Sarah Li. Tom, can you gather HPA and pod statuses; Emma, please prep a status page blurb.

deploy-bot: DEPLOY NOTE · Recent deploy in ap-southeast-1: embed-runtime v2.4.0 deployed at 03:10 UTC by ci/cd pipeline #8276.

Tom Nguyen: running quick checks: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l service=stream-runtime -o wide`
```
NAME                          READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE    NODE
stream-runtime-0              2/2     Running   0          8d    gpu-a1
stream-runtime-1              1/2     CrashLoop 4          12m   gpu-a4
stream-runtime-2              2/2     Running   0          8d    gpu-a2
```

Emma Brooks: status page draft: "We're investigating increased errors for streaming generation in AP-SOUTHEAST-1. Some requests may fail or time out. Our engineering team is working on mitigation; next update in 15 minutes." Approve?

Sarah Li: looks fine. Add note that we're limiting client streaming sessions to 30s to reduce backlog. Add an ETA for next update (15m).

ops-comm: Communication checklist: 1) Status page (Emma) 2) Customer notify template for top affected orgs (ops-comm) 3) Slack post in #status-updates (Sarah) 4) Post-incident owner (Tom) 5) Hand-off instructions for night oncall. Who owns customer outreach?

ops-comm: draft customer message (short): "We experienced elevated errors and timeouts for streaming generation in AP-SOUTHEAST-1 between ~03:10–03:20 UTC affecting a subset of requests. Our engineers applied mitigation and are monitoring. We'll follow up with a post-incident report. Contact support for impact details."

Sarah Li: good draft. Hold sending until we confirm mitigation. Tom, what do pod logs show for the crashing pod?

Tom Nguyen: pulling logs: `kubectl logs stream-runtime-1 -c runtime --since=15m`
```
E0425 03:15:23.112 runtime] OutOfMemoryError: Failed to allocate 1.2G for attention_kernels
Traceback (most recent call last):
  ...
RuntimeError: GPU OOM during model init
```

Sarah Li: GPU OOM on stream-runtime-1 during model init — matches deploy-bot timing. Seems like a model memory regression in v2.4.0. Escalating to runtime lead if they aren't in the room.

deploy-bot: ROLLBACK SUGGESTION · Detected increase in crash loops post-deploy. Suggest rollback to v2.3.7 in region ap-southeast-1. Use `redwoodctl deploy rollback --service=stream-runtime --region=ap-southeast-1 --to-tag=v2.3.7`

Emma Brooks: recommend status page update now: "Mitigation in progress — we've identified a problematic runtime deploy in AP-SOUTHEAST-1 and are rolling back the deploy while adding capacity. Next update in 10 minutes."

Sarah Li: publish that update and create a short internal incident note in #incident-ops with link to war room. I'll execute rollback in a minute and scale up a spare pool.

incident-bot: AUTOMATION · Collected diagnostic bundle: s3://redwood-incident-bundles/INC-20045/2004567890-diagnostics.tar.gz

oncall-sre: initiating rollback: `redwoodctl deploy rollback --service=stream-runtime --region=ap-southeast-1 --to-tag=v2.3.7` — rollback started at 03:22:30 UTC.

Tom Nguyen: scaling up spare capacity: `kubectl scale deployment stream-runtime --replicas=4 -n inference` — adding 1 extra replica from spare pool.

ops-comm: note for customer comms: include affected time window and note that we rolled back a region-specific runtime. Offer a follow-up call if major customers need a technical briefing.

Sarah Li: posted update to status page and pinned in #status-updates. (status link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/20045)

Tom Nguyen: new pods coming up, runtime Ready states: init time ~45s. Watching metrics for error rate drop.

Emma Brooks: queued customer emails (ops-comm template) to top 10 affected accounts; will send after 10m stable window. Draft saved in incident doc.

incident-bot: REMINDER · Please capture pager acknowledgment and handoff notes in incident doc.

Tom Nguyen: metrics show 5xx rate fell from 18.7% -> 2.3% within 6 minutes after rollback + scale. p95 latency improved from 3.8s -> 220ms.

Sarah Li: good — let's set condition: if 5xx < 3% for 10m, move to MONITORING and send customer notes. Otherwise keep war room open.

ops-comm: I'll prepare the final customer email: subject: "Service incident affecting streaming generation in AP-SOUTHEAST-1 — resolved" body includes times, impact summary, and contact link. Waiting for stability check.

deploy-bot: INFO · Rollback completed at 03:28:05 UTC. Released tag v2.3.7 to ap-southeast-1.

incident-bot: PAGER · Pager confirmed by oncall-sre at 2004567960.

Tom Nguyen: handing monitoring to night team. Handoff note: "Rollback applied, 5xx returned to baseline, monitoring for 30 minutes. Pager thresholds: 5xx > 5% or p95 > 1.5s — page oncall."

Sarah Li: assigning follow-ups in incident doc: 1) RCA owner = Tom Nguyen (deep-dive into deploy memory regression) 2) Pre-deploy check ticket for model memory smoke test = Emma Brooks 3) Customer comms send = ops-comm 4) Add alert for post-deploy GPU OOM = oncall-sre.

ops-comm: sending final customer emails now. CC: customer-success@redwood.ai

Emma Brooks: posted final status page update: "Mitigation complete — rollback applied and capacity restored in AP-SOUTHEAST-1. Service has returned to normal. We are investigating and will publish an RCA."

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE · Incident INC-20045 moved to MONITORING at 2004568105.

Sarah Li: closing war room. Handing owner to Tom for RCA and tracking follow-ups. Thanks team — nice quick turnaround. :clap:
